annotations.title: One reported figure with its filings

description: Returns one figure for one company — revenue, gross profit, operating income or net income — over its last eight quarters (fiscal years for a company that files once a year), with the SEC filing behind each period, any value the company filed before a restatement, and a permanent page address for the figure. Use it when the user wants a figure verified, cited or traced to its filings. For every line of the statements over 12 quarters or 6 fiscal years, use get_financials.

metric.description: One of: revenue, grossProfit, operatingIncome, netIncome.

symbol.description: Ticker or company name, e.g. NVDA, AMD, ASML, 'nvidia', 'taiwan semiconductor'. Case-insensitive.
